title: Men in Black on Ashaway Road
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Men in Black on Ashaway Road, about 1990 at Ashaway Road, Rhode Island, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was in it was in um Rhode Island. Uh I lived there in this would have been 1990 when this was happening right around the time of the first Gulf War

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer presented on the show as a historian of the CIA, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about something that happened in 1990 on Ashaway Road in Rhode Island, where he lived, around the time of the first Gulf War. He says he had an encounter there with Men in Black, the mysterious men in dark suits said in UFO stories to visit witnesses, and he connects the story to the rocket scientist Wernher von Braun.
